paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we initiate the study of the Yang-Mills-Higgs-Schrödinger(YMHS) flow, i.e. the Hamiltonian flow of the Yang-Mills-Higgs functional defined on a symplectic fiber bundle. The YMHS flow provides a natural gauge-theoretic extension of the classical Schrödinger flow within the framework of symplectic reduction theory, and generalizes the Chern-Simons-Schrödinger equations to a non-Abelian gauge and non-linear fiber setting. We study its geometric structures and establish the local well-posedness of the corresponding Cauchy problem on compact Riemann surfaces.
